lines.zh: 我踩在地上，每一步都有金属回音
lines.en: Every step I take rings of metal

lines.zh: 炉膛里在烧，火从缝里透出来
lines.en: The furnace burns inside, fire through the seams

lines.zh: 我的关节一节一节地动
lines.en: My joints move one section at a time

lines.zh: 铁脚踩过的地方留下一道黑
lines.en: My iron feet leave a black line

lines.zh: 我走路的声音像铁匠铺
lines.en: My walking sounds like a smithy
A tilt of the head, a recalibration
Heat pours out of my chest

lines.zh: 我不需要歇，我只需要烧
lines.en: I need no rest, I only need to burn

lines.zh: 我照着记忆里的路线走
lines.en: I walk the route in my memory

lines.zh: 身后的空气被烤得扭曲
lines.en: The air behind me warps with heat
I lift a foot and the plate rings

lines.zh: 我不快，可我不会慢下来
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never slow down
I stand, the furnace roaring inside
The eyes are two points of red
There is a weld seam on my shell
I listen to my own furnace
The heat rises in rings

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，可我在耗着什么
lines.en: I do not breathe, yet I consume something

lines.zh: 我把手垂下来，铁声很长
lines.en: I let my hands fall, a long iron sound

lines.zh: 头顶的排气管冒着热气
lines.en: Steam rises from the vent on my head

lines.zh: 我做出来的时候就是这个样子
lines.en: This is how I looked when I was made
A patch of my plating glows red
I am waiting for an instruction

lines.zh: 我的手垂着，指节偶尔动一下
lines.en: My hands hang, the knuckles twitching now and then
A layer of soot sits in the furnace base
I turn my head, iron teeth showing
You are in the light of my furnace

lines.zh: 我这张脸，是照着谁做的
lines.en: Whose face was this modeled on

lines.zh: 你的心跳频率，我记下了
lines.en: I have logged your heart rate

lines.zh: 我没有表情，可我盯着你
lines.en: I have no expression, yet I stare at you
There is metal in your smell

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你怎么还在喘
lines.en: I do not move, why are you still panting
Your position is marked
Do you want to speak to me

lines.zh: 我没有嘴，可我能发出声音
lines.en: I have no mouth, yet I make sound
I take half a step and the ground heats
You backed off, my gaze follows

lines.zh: 我是被做出来的，不是生的
lines.en: I was built, not born

lines.zh: 你看起来像我要找的东西
lines.en: You look like the thing I am looking for
Do not put your hand on this iron
My furnace door is open

lines.zh: 这一层壳，护着里面的火
lines.en: This shell protects the fire within
Listen, it is roaring inside
This body does not tire
A dent in the iron
A wire inside has come loose
My heat output has dropped
I step back and the plate rings
The furnace flame wavered
This damage can be repaired
I do not feel pain, but I record it
Your hand fell heavier than expected
I am still running normally
Can that thing in your hand burn
I open the furnace door wider
Iron eats iron, nothing else
That much will not last one cycle

lines.zh: 你举着它，手被烤到了吧
lines.en: Holding it up, your hand must be roasted

lines.zh: 我不需要喂，我需要燃料
lines.en: I need no feeding, I need fuel

lines.zh: 你递过来的东西，我扫了一遍
lines.en: I scanned what you handed over
It melted a little in my hand
Not enough heat, not enough heat
Move it, you are blocking the vent
You struck iron and the echo ran long

lines.zh: 我没有动，我的重心很低
lines.en: I did not move, my center of mass is low
That burned your hand
Do not press against me, I am hot

lines.zh: 我的外壳有一块是修补的
lines.en: One plate on me is a patch job
Your sole stuck a little as you stepped back
My shoulder pushed you clear

lines.zh: 我计算了你的位置，你没算我
lines.en: I calculated yours, you did not calculate mine

lines.zh: 这一撞，我内部的螺丝松了
lines.en: That loosened a screw inside me
Touch again and I will count you as fuel

lines.zh: 这样的东西，一般是成对做的
lines.en: Such things are usually made in pairs

lines.zh: 我的程序里没有这一项
lines.en: That is not in my instructions

lines.zh: 另一个我，可能在别处烧着
lines.en: Another me may be burning somewhere
Between us there is only fire and iron
Touch it and you will burn

lines.zh: 我不需要陪伴，我需要运转
lines.en: I need no company, I need to run
My furnace cannot stop
Stand back, the heat is severe
Between our kind, it comes down to output
Go, I am going to burn
I reach out, my iron fingers thick
I have it pinched between my fingers
One pinch and the shape is changed
I hold it up to the red glow
This does not burn
I put it at the furnace mouth
It softens in my hand

lines.zh: 我把它拿出来，还是热的
lines.en: I take it out, still hot

lines.zh: 我把它放在地上，地面焦了
lines.en: I set it down, scorching the ground
Do you need this thing
The furnace flared
My feet have already turned
Heat gathers in my chest
I am in this area
I have completed the scan
I can compute your speed
The instruction is simple, pursue
My position is behind you
Iron grinds, the sound coming closer

lines.zh: 我一步跨过你刚才站的地方
lines.en: I step over where you just stood

lines.zh: 你听见炉子的声音了吗
lines.en: Do you hear the furnace
I will not stray from the line
There is no other junction here
I follow squarely, unshaken
Run, my cadence does not change
The direction is computed
You turn, I anticipate
My heat is rising
That road behind the door, I know it better
You stopped, I do not
The iron feet are chasing you
Your position is updated

lines.zh: 这一带都是我烧过的地
lines.en: All this ground has been burnt by me
I am less than ten paces off
I went around that stone
You are drifting as you run

lines.zh: 你的丢弃物我踩过去了
lines.en: I have walked over what you dropped
I am computing a charge
Range is short enough now
My furnace door is open

lines.zh: 我沿着你踩过的地面走
lines.en: I walk the ground you have trodden

lines.zh: 我的热量在靠近时会上升
lines.en: My heat rises as I close in

lines.zh: 我的拳头砸下来，火星四溅
lines.en: My fist comes down in a burst of sparks
My iron hand catches your arm
That blow carried heat
You were shoved back, your clothes smoking

lines.zh: 我的掌心贴在你护甲上
lines.en: My palm pressed to your armor
A weld seam split
That set your armor glowing
My forearm swings through
You hear iron strike iron

lines.zh: 我的动作不快，可不好躲
lines.en: I am not quick, and I am hard to avoid

lines.zh: 这一下，你半边身子发麻
lines.en: That numbed half your body

lines.zh: 我从上方砸落，火星散开。
lines.en: I drop from above, sparks scattering.
Fire sprays from the seam
Hold on a little longer and see
Iron struck the ground
My furnace lit for the first time
I stand and the heat spreads
Whoever made me is long gone
The ground jumped as I touched down
My eyes came alight
My joints are not yet worn in
This area is about to get hot
I was set upright and I hold
My head turned once, scan complete
The furnace door clanked once
The air warps beside me
One lift of my foot and the plate answers
Everything here is logged
Sparks fall at my feet
I have started to burn
There are several more behind me, all the same
I await the first instruction
This area is mine from today
The core burns redder

lines.zh: 我的炉子更旺了，火不伤我
lines.en: My furnace burned brighter, fire does not harm me

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，铁板被砸穿
lines.en: I fell from height and a plate punched through
Water went in and I steamed
The blast dented half my face

lines.zh: 一支箭打在铁上，弹出去
lines.en: The arrow struck iron and bounced off

lines.zh: 那股劲儿钻进了我的线路
lines.en: That force got into my circuits
Fuel is nearly gone, the flame shrinks

lines.zh: 雷打进来，我里面全亮了一下
lines.en: Lightning entered and everything inside flashed

lines.zh: 这里没有地面，我的铁身往下坠
lines.en: No ground here, my iron body falls
